Chapter 6 - Component Manager / Component Manager Reference

Application-Defined Routine

To provide a component, you define a component function and supply the appropriate registration information. You store your component function in a code resource and typically store your component's registration information as resources in a component file. For additional information on this process, see "Creating Components" beginning on page 6-12.
